title: Inspired by Fart Together, but with shouting sea lions, and it runs in your browser.
author: InfernoGuard
selftext:
Spent the weekend making a dumb little co-op game. you're sea lions on an ice floe going down a glacier, and the only way to steer is shouting BAAAH at the right moment. with 4 people it turns into pure chaos pretty fast

it's free and runs in the browser, phone or pc, no account or install. one person makes a room, sends the link, everyone joins from their own device. there's also a 2 player mode on one keyboard. you can record your own shout too which is way funnier than it should be

inspired by fart together, but with shouting sea lions

[https://baaah.io](https://baaah.io)

still super fresh so if something breaks or annoys you tell me
